description: 1bit engine: model-agnostic local LLM inference on the AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 (Strix Halo) inside Lemonade Server, on Linux: HRX with HIP kernels on the Radeon 8060S iGPU and our own runtime on the XDNA 2 NPU, behind an OpenAI-compatible API.
rules: Serve models with `1bit serve`; it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and runs as Lemonade's `onebit` backend.

Pick the device with `--device` (auto, npu, hrx, cpu, ds4); an NPU model directory runs on the NPU fast lane, and `auto` runs plain GGUF files on HRX. On the GPU the engine is pure HRX with HIP kernels (no Vulkan, ROCm backend, Metal, ZINC or CUDA): Lemonade's own backends serve those.
Prefer Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs: UD-Q4_K_XL is the lean default, UD-Q5_K_XL the accurate choice.
For one user at a time use `--mtp`; for many simultaneous requests use `--parallel`.
Documentation lives at https://1bit.gg; measured results are on the GitHub wiki.
